name: Bremer Lagerhaus-Gesellschaft AG
summary: Bremer Lagerhaus-Gesellschaft -Aktiengesellschaft von 1877- provides seaport-oriented logistics services in Germany, operating through Automobile, Contract, and Container divisions, offering seaport terminals for car handling, inland terminals, vehicle storage, technical services, and multimodal distribution by road, rail, and inland waterways. Headquartered in Bremen, Germany.
